name: Škocjan Caves
description: Beneath Slovenia's Karst plateau, the Škocjan Caves twist through about 6 km of limestone passages that plunge more than 200 m deep. Visitors descend past collapsed sinkholes, thundering underground waterfalls and one of the largest known subterranean chambers. The region gave karst landscapes their name, and these caves are among the world's most famous places to study how they form.
